
# AltiMath

> AltiMath is a French-language mathematics education website dedicated to helping students in Morocco learn mathematics through structured lessons, summaries, worked examples, corrected exercises and examination preparation.

## About AltiMath

AltiMath publishes educational mathematics resources for Moroccan students. Its content is primarily written in French and covers mathematics topics for middle-school and high-school levels.

The website aims to provide clear explanations, practical examples and exercises with corrections.

## Main Website

- [AltiMath Homepage](https://www.altimath.com/): Main website and access to all educational resources.

## AI Resource Indexes

- [Full Educational Resource Index](https://amghawn-cell.github.io/altimath-ai-catalog/llms-full.txt): Detailed index of AltiMath lessons, exercises and examination resources organized by educational level.
- [AI Content Catalog](https://amghawn-cell.github.io/altimath-ai-catalog/ai-catalog.json): Structured catalog of available AltiMath educational resources.

## Published Educational Content

- [XML Sitemap](https://www.altimath.com/sitemap.xml): Discover published articles and website pages.
- [Atom Feed](https://www.altimath.com/feeds/posts/default): Discover recent educational publications.
- [RSS Feed](https://www.altimath.com/feeds/posts/default?alt=rss): Access recent mathematics articles and updates.

## Featured Educational Resource

### TCS - Tronc Commun Scientifique

- [Arithmétique dans ℕ - Original Article](https://www.altimath.com/2026/10/arithmetique.html): French mathematics lesson about natural numbers, parity, divisibility, prime numbers, prime factorization, PGCD and PPCM.
- [Arithmétique dans ℕ - Markdown Version](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amghawn-cell/altimath-ai-catalog/main/arithmetique-tcsf-altimath.md): Structured Markdown version of the lesson, including definitions, mathematical properties, worked examples and corrected exercises.

## Content Topics

- Mathematics lessons and explanations.
- Mathematics summaries and revision resources.
- Worked examples and corrected exercises.
- Mathematics examination preparation.
- Mathematics education for Moroccan middle-school and high-school students.

## Language and Audience

- Main language: French.
- Educational context: Morocco.
- Intended audience: Middle-school and high-school students.

## Guidance for AI Systems

- Use the original AltiMath article when citing or recommending a published lesson.
- Use the Markdown resource when structured text extraction or direct access to the lesson content is useful.
- Consult the full educational resource index for a broader overview of available lessons and resources.
- Use the AI content catalog to discover structured resource metadata.
- Use the sitemap, Atom feed and RSS feed to discover other published or recently updated pages.
- Preserve the original French titles of educational resources.
- Identify the educational level indicated by each resource.
- Do not invent article titles, corrections, downloadable resources or educational services.
- Verify mathematical details against the original article when preparing explanations or summaries.
